title: AI Project Management: Shipping AI into Production (Paul Phelps)
summary: Paul Phelps (experienced project & product manager) explains why AI projects stall in organizations, which legacy PM assumptions break for AI, and practical patterns to increase the odds of actually getting AI into production.
